messages:
nina: Hey team  I'm starting with Redwood on Jul 1 but need to be in Seoul for family for the first 30 days of July. Can I do onboarding remotely from Seoul and still receive the monthly WFH stipend? Any payroll/tax or equipment notes I should know about?

harry: congrats and welcome! :tada: short answer: you can onboard remotely, but you must submit a Temporary Remote Location (TRL) so payroll/legal can flag it. stipend eligibility depends on your declared homebase. Will homebase stay US?

nina: yes homebase stays US, payroll stays USD. my start date is fixed so i need access to onboarding sessions (timezone questions) and the laptop.

harry: timezone ops: we'll make sure sessions are recorded and try to give live options if necessary. equipment: we typically do not ship laptops internationally for new hires. can you pick up in the US before you go, or wait until you return?

nina: i can pick it up from my parents' place before flying out. thanks.

payroll-bot: Ticket created: #PR-8150  "Seoul 30d: onboarding + TRL check for nina"  assigned to sujin. ETA 1 business day. :ticket:

sujin: taking this. quick Qs: will you be doing any local customer meetings or contractor engagements while in Seoul? and will you open a local bank account or receive local payments?

nina: no client meetings, no local bank, just remote onboarding and normal contributor work hours.

sujin: ok that's simpler. because it's 30 days we usually won't see employer registration triggers, but we still need the TRL so payroll can pro-rate any stipend and note the timezones for onboarding. please submit start/end dates and attach flights.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: TRL form is under Benefits -> Location Changes. Attach flight or booking and include start/end dates. If you're a new hire include "onboarding" in the notes so DevEd can prioritize recordings.

nina: submitted TRL TL-6123 (Jul 1Jul 30) and noted "new hire onboarding overlap". included flight confirmation.

payroll-bot: Update on #PR-8150  TL-6123 received, sujin added note: USD payroll; awaiting legal confirmation.

harry: stipend proration note: stipend pays monthly and is pro-rated by days in month where you're physically remote. since July is full month for your TRL you'll get the normal monthly stipend only if homebase remains US in the HR portal. If you change homebase it may convert currency and taxes.

nina: great. any impact to benefits or health while i'm in Seoul? i'll be remote, likely using US telehealth occasionally.

sujin: Redwood plans cover emergency care internationally for short stays, telehealth from US providers should work but check appointment hours with DevEd for onboarding. if you anticipate routine local care, consider travel insurance.

people-ops-bot: Ops note: we do not ship company hardware internationally; good call picking up the laptop beforehand. Connection stipend: short-term connection or coworking can be expensed up to $150 with receipts.

nina: thanks  would it be possible to pre-authorize the coworking stipend? onboarding has a few synchronous days and I might need a stable coworking desk.

sujin: yes we can pre-authorize up to $150 for documented coworking for new hires during TRL. add a note in your TRL attachments and we'll flag the ticket for quick reimbursement.

nina: added coworking request note to TL-6123. appreciate the fast responses.

payroll-bot: #PR-8150 last updated 2199000190: awaiting legal confirm (sujin).
